_comment: MemoryRecord placement: later governed memory lifecycle. Persistence: deferred memory platform plus EventLedger provenance. Concurrency: memoryId plus version compare-and-set.

_ignores.propose: the machine starts at Candidate; duplicate proposal is idempotent by memoryId
_ignores.supersede: candidate memory has no active predecessor

_ignores.approve: the record is already approved; reapproval requires a new version
_ignores.recall: approved memory is not active until deletion and provenance checks pass
_ignores.supersede: only active memory can be superseded

_ignores.propose: a new candidate requires a new memoryId
_ignores.approve: the active record is already approved

_ignores.propose: a successor candidate owns the new proposal
_ignores.approve: the record is historical and cannot be reactivated
_ignores.recall: only the successor may be recalled
